text:
No option can be put forward yet because the under‑4% monthly churn condition was not checkable in this run.

- The comparison across £49, £55 and £59/month was robust under the changes tested, but that is only an MRR-relative result—not evidence that any price meets both of your stated goals.
- Monthly churn is modelled as a calculated outcome rather than a directly comparable reading, so the strict `<4% per month` limit was excluded. The £20k MRR target’s measurement frame and objective direction were also not fully specified.
- The result remains provisional: four underlying inputs were supplied by Olumi rather than evidenced by you, including the drivers around subscribers, churn and feature-release value.
